name: print-social-planner-notebook-orange-checklist
title: Spiral notebook weekly content planner checklist
whatItIs: A square post styled as a photographed spiral-bound notebook page on an orange background, listing six weekly content-planning tasks each with a checkbox circle.
whatItMeans: Framing a checklist as a 'real notebook page' rather than a flat digital list makes routine productivity content feel more personal and tactile, encouraging a viewer to treat it like a to-do list.
techniques: render a checklist as a photographed physical notebook page rather than flat digital text
use open circle checkboxes to invite a viewer to mentally (or literally) tick items off
let torn paper/color shapes bleed off-canvas at the edges for a scrapbook, non-static feel

vocabulary.definition: a list format pairing each item with an empty box or circle, implying actionable, completable steps
